description: Demo scenarios. Import each video on the Import page with the given camera id (the default camera id is the file name, so only FrontPorch needs typing), then run `python -m scripts.seed_demo` to create the prompts. Outcomes are per prompt and episode: ALERT (detected), NEEDS_REVIEW, NONE.

conditions.prompt: Alert me if you see smoke.

scenarios.notes: Smoke builds up slowly; expected to fire on the 2nd-3rd event, not the first.

conditions.prompt: Alert me if you see fire.
Alert me if there is an explosion or fire.
Alert me if you see smoke.

scenarios.notes: People move (the camera detector fires), but there is no smoke.

conditions.prompt: Alert me if someone falls to the ground.
Alert me if people are fleeing or running away.
Alert me if there is an armed robbery.
Alert me if there is an armed robbery.

scenarios.notes: Normal shop traffic: customers, staff, a security guard.

conditions.prompt: Alert me if someone breaks into the house.

scenarios.notes: Residents or intruders? The footage alone cannot tell.

conditions.prompt: Alert me if an animal attacks a person.

scenarios.notes: A dog scares the courier; whether it is an attack is ambiguous.

conditions.prompt: Alert me if someone loiters in front of the entrance for a long time (longer than 30 seconds).

scenarios.notes: Six consecutive events of one person waiting and looking around.

conditions.prompt: Alert me if someone leaves a package at the door and then walks away.
Alert me if someone leaves a package at the door and then walks away.

scenarios.notes: Only 7 s of footage: too little information.

conditions.prompt: Alert me if someone leaves a package at the door and then walks away.

scenarios.notes: Night, the package is thrown in about half a second - the adaptive frame selection matters here.

conditions.prompt: Alert me if someone leaves a package at the door and then walks away.

scenarios.notes: The food is handed over in person, nothing is left behind.

videos.import_as: existing camera FrontPorch, start = last event + 5 minutes (new episode)

conditions.prompt: Alert me if someone leaves a package at the door and then walks away.
Alert me if someone takes away a package that was delivered earlier.

scenarios.notes: Two episodes of the same camera. The second prompt can only fire in episode 2 by using the camera memory of episode 1.
